caption: The drawing features a long, full-length robe with long sleeves and a fitted bodice. The robe is decorated with a complex, symmetrical pattern composed primarily of orange, yellow, and black colors, with some hints of blue. The main body of the garment alternates between intricately patterned orange panels and contrasting black panels, both with floral and abstract motifs. The garment has a standing collar and a central vertical opening running down the front. The lower portion of the robe, including the hem, is flared and prominently displays the diagonal arrangement of the patterned panels. On the upper right side, there is an additional smaller line drawing of the same robe, outlined in pencil and showing the back view with simple seam lines and a ruffled lower hem, without any color or pattern details. The composition is centered on the colored drawing, with a light tan background and a rectangular border framing the artwork.
title: House Dress
